s.d: The sound of a game show buzzer or of electricity. Often used as a reaction to a wrong answer.
s.e: The buzzer on Matthew's desk rang violently at this point, bzzt-bzzt...
The sound of the arrows was bzzzt, bzzzt, like the buzzing of flies. I know of no more maddening noise than the singing of arrows past the ear.

s.d: The buzzing sound of a bee, wasp, etc.
To make a buzzing sound like that of a bee or wasp.
